buffer_size.description: Output buffer size in bytes for low-memory mode. Use powers of 2 between 12-29 or explicit byte counts.

force.description: Force overwrite of existing output files (--force).

test_mode.description: Test integrity of compressed file without extracting (--test).

trailing_error.description: Exit with error if trailing data is found (--trailing-error).

list_mode.description: List file sizes instead of decompressing (--list).
